name: University of Utah
description: The University of Utah is a public research university located in Salt Lake City, Utah. It is the flagship institution of the Utah System of Higher Education and nationally ranked Top 100 by U.S.News and World Report(2021). In addition, one of 63 universities in the United States to become a member of the Association of American Universities. A prestigious grouping of elite American universities. Twenty-two Rhodes Scholars, four Nobel Prize winners, three Turing Award winners, eight MacArthur Fellows, various Pulitzer Prize winners, two astronauts, Gates Cambridge Scholars, and Churchill Scholars have been affiliated with university students, researchers, or faculty members in its history.
